body:
## Summary
- Replaces the earlier dense weapon poster set with 20 new `Tactic Line` poster variants using centered side-view armory weapon sprites.
- Adds one centered single-weapon version for each armory weapon, including ASVK, plus controlled multi-weapon layouts.
- Keeps red/black variants mostly black/gray with red limited to title, contours, and glow; validation caps red-dominant pixels under 10%.
- Removes the four previous rejected poster PNGs and refreshes the contact sheet.
- Updates `docs/case-studies/issue-1815/` with latest issue/PR data, follow-up feedback, online research notes, solution analysis, and validation details.
- Updates `experiments/generate_tactic_line_posters.py` and `experiments/validate_tactic_line_posters.py` so the batch is reproducible and checked.

## Preview
![Tactic Line poster contact sheet](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-godot-topdown-MVP/blob/issue-1815-1939c94afb26/assets/posters/tactic_line_poster_contact_sheet.png?raw=true)

- [Multi: Balanced Loadout](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-godot-topdown-MVP/blob/issue-1815-1939c94afb26/assets/posters/tactic_line_multi_balanced_loadout.png?raw=true)
- [Red/Black: ASVK](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-godot-topdown-MVP/blob/issue-1815-1939c94afb26/assets/posters/tactic_line_red_black_asvk.png?raw=true)
- [Red/Black: Loadout](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-godot-topdown-MVP/blob/issue-1815-1939c94afb26/assets/posters/tactic_line_red_black_loadout.png?raw=true)

## Reproduction
Run:

```bash
python3 experiments/generate_tactic_line_posters.py
```

This regenerates the 20 poster PNGs plus the contact sheet from existing repo assets.

## Validation
- `python3 experiments/validate_tactic_line_posters.py`
- `python3 -m py_compile experiments/generate_tactic_line_posters.py experiments/validate_tactic_line_posters.py`
- `python3 tests/test_icon_ico.py`
- `git diff --check`
- `dotnet build` passes with `0 Warning(s), 0 Error(s)`.
- Godot CLI (`godot`/`godot4`) is unavailable in this container, so GUT tests were not run locally.

Fixes #1815
